name: Audit Trail & Event Logging Validation
objectives: Verify that all security-critical actions produce audit trail entries with correct actor/action/entity attribution
Validate secret access events are logged with access outcome (granted/denied/redacted)
Ensure audit log immutability: non-admin actors cannot delete or modify audit entries
Verify redaction pipeline strips API keys, JWT tokens, passwords, OS usernames, and home directory paths
Validate cross-company audit isolation: company A cannot read company B's audit trail
Verify cost event attribution links correctly to agent/company/run context
Validate log retention policies enforce correct expiry windows (7d plugin, 90d activity, 365d cost/secret)
Ensure real-time SSE audit event publishing includes correct event type mapping
Validate regression tests for Milestones 1.3A and 1.3B remain intact
Output validation scorecard and pass autonomous self-test gate checks
